reason.description: 一句话：为什么有/没有事件

from_entity.description: Canonical id from the entity list, or NEW:<Official company name>. order=buyer/payer; investment=investor; debt=borrower; lease=lessee (user of the equipment/site); guarantee=guarantor; vendor_financing=the vendor extending credit; guidance=the reporting company.

to_entity.description: order=seller/provider; investment=investee; debt=lender (pooled: BONDHOLDERS / LENDER_SYNDICATE / PRIVATE_CREDIT); lease=lessor/financier; guarantee=beneficiary; vendor_financing=the customer receiving credit; guidance=empty string.

amount_usd.description: Total value in USD as a plain number; null if not stated.

amount_text.description: Amount as written, incl. 'up to', currency, per-year figures.

instrument.description: order: compute_contract|colocation|chip_purchase|power|equipment|other. investment: primary|secondary|acquisition|warrant|convertible|jv_equity|other. debt: bond|convertible|term_loan|ddtl|revolver|abs|gpu_backed_loan|bridge|other. lease: gpu_lease|site_lease|other. guarantee: lease_guarantee|credit_support|offtake_guarantee|other. vendor_financing: chip_financing|other. guidance: capex|rpo|backlog|total_debt|compute_commitments|other.

term.description: Term / duration as written, e.g. '5 years', 'through 2030'; empty if none.

capacity.description: Capacity as written (GW, MW, GPUs); empty if none.

announced.description: Announcement date YYYY-MM-DD (use the article date if the deal is announced in it).

period.description: guidance only: fiscal period the number refers to.

status.description: rumored = media citing sources / in talks; announced = officially announced, not yet signed/closed; signed = definitive agreement; completed = closed/funded/priced; amended = changes an earlier deal; cancelled = terminated or superseded.

title_zh.description: 一行中文标题，≤ 30 字：谁向谁、什么、多少钱

summary_zh.description: 一两句中文：交易内容、期限、条件、与已有交易的关系

quote.description: Verbatim sentence from the article stating the commitment (<= 250 chars).
